decoded_constants.value: Attempt to hide the toast outside of YouTube Plus detected.

limitations: Opaque forwarded setPlaybackView:, setActionBarElementRenderer: and factory entry source types are absent; uintptr_t preserves raw x2 without added ARC ownership.
Host UIKit/YouTube objects are synthetic in runtime tests; iOS production compile uses real SDK headers. Device interaction has not been tested.
Canonical local feature policy is parent-owned and differs from packaged licensing/bootstrap policy.
Obfuscation and injected supervisor calls are not reproduced.
